symptoms: Rapidly enlarging water-soaked dark brown/black lesions on foliage and stems
White moldy sporulation on leaf undersides in morning dew
Tuber dry rot with reddish-brown granular flesh beneath skin
risk_factors: Cool, wet conditions (15-20°C) with prolonged rainfall or humidity
prevention: Plant only certified disease-free seed tubers
Eliminate cull piles and volunteer potatoes that harbor overwintering mycelium
recommended_actions: Apply systemic late-blight fungicides immediately upon regional blight alerts
